findings.detail: RecursiveReviewScope: invariants require each reviewed path to retain its repository and trusted revision context, including applicable historical guidance. Ratings: encapsulation 7/10, invariant expression 6/10, invariant usefulness 9/10, invariant enforcement 6/10. The new traversal includes child files such as module/src/file.go, but render_guides resolves module/AGENTS.md against only the superproject's baseline and object database. That lookup cannot traverse a gitlink, so mandatory child instructions are omitted while the prompt prohibits reading checkout instructions. A validated recursive scope can therefore produce a successful review without its required checks.
findings.fix: Resolve each child's repository and trusted revision recursively from the parent baseline's gitlink, then use that context for historical guide discovery. Explicitly handle children absent from the baseline and unavailable historical objects without substituting current child HEAD.
findings.title: write-bash-scripts: Checked commands: Recursive scopes omit trusted child guidance context.
